en: Emilio Aguinaldo was the first president of the Philippines, not Jose Rizal.
The Philippines declared independence from Spain on June 12, 1898, not July 4.
The Congress makes the national laws, while the President only enforces them.
The sampaguita is the national flower of the Philippines, not the waling-waling orchid.
Lapu-Lapu was a Visayan chieftain from Mactan, not a Tagalog leader from Luzon.
The Philippines has two official languages, Filipino and English, alongside many regional languages.
Ferdinand Magellan did not discover the Philippines, as indigenous Filipinos already inhabited the islands.
Emilio Aguinaldo designed the Philippine flag himself, not a Spanish or American colonizer.
The Supreme Court interprets the law, while only the Congress can create new laws.
The Tinikling dance originated in the Philippine province of Leyte, not in Spain.
Voting in the Philippines is a voluntary right, not a mandatory legal duty.
The Ifugao people carved the Banaue Rice Terraces using simple hand tools, without modern machines.
